about: Atelier is a working AI studio a team can use on day one. A content team writes product copy, makes product photos, short clips, voiceovers and music beds, and asks questions of its own brand guides and customer calls. Every output lands in a Library with how it was made: the prompt, the model, the settings, who made it and what it cost. Admins set a monthly budget for the team and for each person, and approve runs above a line they choose.
